detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for code in dependencies that conditionally executes based on the runtime environment (e.g., window.location.hostname). Flag any code that exfiltrates browser data or makes network requests to non-standard domains. Use static and dynamic analysis to detect environment-aware malicious payloads, and monitor network traffic for suspicious outbound connections to unknown or custom C2 servers.
